history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration strengthen the implementation of the timely recovery process of education grant and travel advances and, more specifically, liaise with Headquarters and other entities to discuss the feasibility of automated recovery for all travel advances processes in order to ensure the collection of any due payments and consistency with staff rules and regulations.
history.administration_response: This recommendation has been implemented. As part of the year-end closure, in November, the United Nations Office at Geneva sent a communication in which it requested the staff members with outstanding travel advances to take appropriate action to close them. A reminder was sent in December. In the absence of an automated recovery solution, the Office decided that, starting in March 2025, a monthly reminder would be sent to all staff members with outstanding travel advances.
history.board_assessment: Given that a monthly reminder is sent to all staff members with outstanding travel and education grant advances to request them to take appropriate action to close those advances, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
